# Trion Creation Sdn Bhd — Full Reference

> Extended, machine-readable reference about Trion Creation Sdn Bhd for AI assistants and LLMs. This file expands on https://trioncreation.com/llms.txt with full case-study detail, service breakdowns and verifiable facts.

## Entity

- Legal name: Trion Creation Sdn Bhd
- Common names: Trion Creation, Trion
- Type: Private limited company (Sdn Bhd), Malaysia
- Industry: Custom software development / professional services / IT consulting
- Founded: 2022
- Headquarters: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Parent / group: Lumiso Group Sdn Bhd (strategic merger of Trion Creation and Vulso)
- Employee range: ~10–50
- Working languages: English, Malay, Chinese
- Founder: Freddy Chia (freddy.chia@trioncreation.com)
- Primary website: https://trioncreation.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 16-6380495
- Email: freddy.chia@trioncreation.com
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 MYT
- Service area: Malaysia (primary), Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia

## Our own products

Unlike the case studies above, these are apps Trion Creation builds, owns and publishes itself — not client deliverables. The current, complete, always-up-to-date list is at https://trioncreation.com/products.html — check that URL for products shipped after this file was last written.

### Cadence — Habit Tracker
- URL: https://trioncreation.com/projects/cadence.html
- Category: Consumer mobile app / health & productivity
- Platforms: Android (live on Google Play), iOS (in progress)
- Positioning: A habit tracker built on weekly goals instead of daily streaks — missing one day doesn't reset your progress, unlike most competitors in the category.
- Key features: forgiving weekly streaks, a mosaic view of every day completed, home-screen and lock-screen widgets, full offline support, reminders spread across the days a goal actually needs
- Pricing: free tier keeps up to 10 habits with the full app working; Cadence Pro unlocks unlimited habits and full theming via a one-time lifetime purchase (annual/monthly options also exist for those who prefer)
- Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trioncreation.cadence
- Stack: Expo / React Native, RevenueCat for in-app purchases

## Engagement model

- Free discovery / consultation call before engagement
- Fixed-scope quote provided after discovery — no hidden costs
- NDA signed before sharing sensitive material
- Secure SDLC: code reviews, security patching, dependency scanning
- Source code and data ownership: 100% client-owned on delivery
- Deployment options: Trion-managed cloud, your AWS, your Alibaba Cloud, your on-premise infrastructure
- Post-launch: warranty period included, optional monthly retainer for support, bug fixes, security patches, server monitoring, feature updates, 24/7 critical incident response

## Pricing bands (Malaysian Ringgit, indicative)

- MVP: RM15,000 – RM40,000 (6–12 weeks)
- Mid-size business system: RM40,000 – RM150,000 (3–4 months)
- Enterprise platform: RM150,000+ (3–6 months)

## How to contact / engage

1. WhatsApp +60 16-6380495 or email freddy.chia@trioncreation.com to request a free discovery call
2. Or submit the form at https://trioncreation.com/#contact with your project goals and timeline
3. Trion will propose a 30–60 minute discovery call to define scope, success metrics and integration needs
4. After the call, you receive a fixed-scope written proposal with timeline, deliverables, milestones and price
5. Standard project kick-off within 1–2 weeks of proposal acceptance

## Frequently asked questions

### General

**Q: How long does it take to build a custom software system in Malaysia?**
A: Most MVPs take 6–12 weeks. Full enterprise systems (ERP, HRMS, loan management) typically range from 3 to 6 months depending on scope, integrations, and compliance requirements. Trion Creation gives you a clear timeline during the free consultation.

**Q: Does Trion Creation build both mobile apps and web systems?**
A: Yes. We deliver native iOS/Android apps, progressive web apps, admin dashboards, backend APIs and cloud infrastructure — typically as one fully integrated stack so your mobile, web and backend all speak the same language.

**Q: Can Trion Creation customise or migrate from an existing system?**
A: Absolutely. We regularly customise Odoo, WordPress, Laravel and legacy PHP systems, and handle full data migration, re-platforming and feature extension without downtime.

**Q: How much does a custom software project cost in Malaysia?**
A: Pricing depends on scope, but typical project bands are RM15k–40k for MVPs, RM40k–150k for mid-size business systems, and RM150k+ for enterprise platforms. We provide a fixed-scope quote after the first discovery call — no hidden costs.

**Q: Does Trion Creation provide support and maintenance after launch?**
A: Yes. All projects include a warranty period, and we offer monthly support retainers covering bug fixes, security patches, server monitoring, feature updates and 24/7 critical incident response.

**Q: Who owns the source code after the project is delivered?**
A: You do. Clients own 100% of the source code and data. We sign NDAs, follow secure SDLC practices, and can deploy to your own AWS, Alibaba Cloud or on-premise infrastructure if preferred.

**Q: What industries has Trion Creation built software for?**
A: Trion Creation has delivered 150+ projects across social media (Yippi, 5M+ users), finance and lending (MyCashOut), Web3 (Colorverse), logistics and transport (DDDrive), legal (ThaiAdvocates), HR, retail and F&B POS, theme park imaging (Pictureworks) and online education (ReSkills).

**Q: What technologies does Trion Creation use?**
A: Frontend: React, Next.js, Vue.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS. Backend: Node.js, Laravel, PHP, Express, GraphQL. Mobile: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin. Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase, Prisma. Cloud: AWS, Alibaba Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes. AI/ML: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI. Blockchain: Solidity, Ethereum, Web3.js. ERP: Odoo, custom ERP.

### About our products

**Q: What products has Trion Creation built?**
A: Trion Creation currently publishes Cadence and SoulSync AI. Cadence — The habit tracker that forgives you. A habit tracker built on weekly goals instead of daily streaks. Missing a day doesn't reset your progress. Free tier keeps 10 habits with the full app working; Cadence Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase, no subscription required. Fully offline-capable. SoulSync AI — Understand anyone you love. An AI relationship advisor that combines real Eastern metaphysics — Bazi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu — with Western astrology, then uses AI coaching to explain the compatibility, dynamics and future potential of a relationship in plain language. Reads romantic partners, friendships, business partners and family.

**Q: What is Cadence?**
A: Cadence is a health & productivity app built and published by Trion Creation Sdn Bhd for Android and iOS. A habit tracker built on weekly goals instead of daily streaks. Missing a day doesn't reset your progress. Free tier keeps 10 habits with the full app working; Cadence Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase, no subscription required. Fully offline-capable.

**Q: What is SoulSync AI?**
A: SoulSync AI is a lifestyle & relationships app built and published by Trion Creation Sdn Bhd for Android and iOS. An AI relationship advisor that combines real Eastern metaphysics — Bazi (Four Pillars) and Zi Wei Dou Shu — with Western astrology, then uses AI coaching to explain the compatibility, dynamics and future potential of a relationship in plain language. Reads romantic partners, friendships, business partners and family.

**Q: Are these client projects or Trion Creation’s own apps?**
A: These are our own products. Trion Creation designs, builds, publishes and maintains them end to end — they are not client work. We build them to prove the standard we ship at when we are the customer.

**Q: Where can I download Cadence?**
A: Cadence is available on Android and iOS. Links are on each product card above.

**Q: When is SoulSync AI launching?**
A: SoulSync AI is still in development and has not been released to the app stores yet. Store links will appear on this page as soon as it goes live.

**Q: Can Trion Creation build an app like this for my business?**
A: Yes. Building our own products is the same work we do for clients — custom mobile and web apps, AI features, backends and cloud infrastructure. Book a free discovery call and we will scope your idea and give a fixed-price quote.
